title: MEIKO — Dependable Warmth〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day before the solo show
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day of their solo show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm hoping that they're all able to get in a good night's rest...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: D-Do you think they're gonna be okay...? I-I'm starting to get really worried!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you're not the one that's gonna be performing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But they might actually get to go pro if it goes well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True. This is sort of a once in a lifetime opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I've gotta think there are a lot of bands out there that've never even been given this chance...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is their first, but I hope they try to take advantage of it like it's their last.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Th-They will...!
I mean, they've been practicing like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Y-Y-Yeah!
They'll totally do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you never know what's gonna happen during any show, right? What if they have an equipment malfunction?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: At the same time, Shiho works where they're gonna play, so I'm sure they'll figure out—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, wait...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you poking me...? Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You didn't have to jinx them like that, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-Sorry... But you really shouldn't be so worried if you actually believe in Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-I'm not worried... I'm totally fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? You definitely don't seem fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, let's all just settle down.
Miku and Rin for one, but you too, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me? But I feel fine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? All those negative thoughts running through your head... You're actually really worried, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, you're also worried...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Why didn't you just say you were?! You didn't have to spell out that nightmare scenario to us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Shut up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, you two, no fighting.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know this probably won't solve anything, but we just need to believe that they'll do well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Miku said so herself.
They've been practicing like there's no tomorrow, so I'm sure their hard work will be rewarded.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know so!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If anything, we just need to have faith in them and think, “They'll do just fine!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because we've all watched them work and practice like their lives depend on it, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's right. They've all been working so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, all that's left is to enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They told us that we'll be able to watch from somewhere safe, so let's try to have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Yes.
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Quiver*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin? Are you still worried?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, I feel a lot better!
Actually, I feel really excited now♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You do? That was quick.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know how Rin feels.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel like playing something now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah!
We should have a quick session since we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to get our instruments.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Agreed! So, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
